verdict.rationale: Discord documents a Gateway API that lets apps open secure WebSocket connections to receive real-time server/guild events. Bots authenticate with a bot token, and event notifications can also be delivered to an app over HTTP, so the core of the story is clearly delivered by first-party docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that message-content events are delivered (the cited examples are channel and role events), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the gateway's real-time behavior.
